title: Snapshot paging and response limits
rule: Snapshot pagination freezes ordered complete items on first read, bound to authenticated owner, query and resource version. Opaque cursors expire after 15 minutes. Default 20 and maximum 50 items; complete non-image MCP envelopes are strictly below 20000 UTF-8 bytes. Oversized individual items return an actionable error and resource reference; never truncate an element.
alternatives: Leave this decision deferred and block dependent implementation.
